testcase.name: Scenario: Use horizontal arrows at Part template group boundaries: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/current-document-creation-navigation-source/features/application/document-creation/document-creation-navigation-native.feature:45:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Use horizontal arrows at Part template group boundaries ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-navigation-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And its Metric folder contains exactly the four named native part templates used below ✔> And its English folder contains the standard inch part template ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And the template chooser shows the metric folder grouped by type using Medium icons ✔ And the user sizes the chooser so the gallery has a horizontal scrollbar and moves it to its leftmost position ✔ And the Part group begins with Sheet Metal (DIN) and ends with Standard (mm) ✔ When the user selects Standard (mm) and presses Right ✔ Then Standard (mm) remains selected and identified in the details pane ✔ And the gallery scroll position advances within the Part group ✔ When the user presses Left ✔ Then Standard (DIN) is selected and identified in the details pane ✔ When the user presses Home and then Left ✔ Then Sheet Metal (DIN) remains selected and identified in the details pane ✔ And the gallery returns to its leftmost horizontal position ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the chooser closes and the original part remains active
